scope: Complete numeric-free outer input decoding and canonical custody; controlled producer work only, no arbitrary native or JavaScript heap guarantee

rules.conjunction: All ceilings apply together with smaller original enclosing allowances; maxima are not a promise that all fit simultaneously
rules.source: Retain original immutable bytes; raw, canonical and framed artifacts remain distinct and are charged while coexisting
rules.structure: Each scalar, object or array counts as a node; each child adds one depth. Reserve before frame/slot/string allocation
rules.work: Charge every inspected byte, each full duplicate-name comparison byte, each scalar conversion, and every verification/canonical/hash/copy pass; actual repeated work never resets
rules.ownership: Charge conservative qualified original frame/container/slot/string/buffer allocation bounds; raw/output byte length alone does not account for host objects or copies
rules.nativeRegistry: Retained operation artifacts still obey one-MiB individual and four-MiB six-artifact aggregate admission; this parser profile cannot increase either limit
rules.dependencies: Pre-admit actual schema validator, canonical encoder, hash/base64 and other producer peak/work bounds. Missing bounds refuse before invocation

failure: Resource refusal with no partial tree, issued input, native effects or representation fallback; retain original containment/recovery custody
qualificationRequired: Exact immutable implementation/build and original issuer/account registration
Independent byte oracle plus exact/one-over structural, output, work and peak controls
Real packed browser and selected host observations of reserve-before-work behavior
Complete original source/canonical/framed correspondence and aggregate operation custody
